name: data-platform-database-result-contracts-wave15-runtime
salesforceExclusionReason: This fixture proves Glade-local Database result DTO aliases and accessors through real local DML results. It does not establish hosted Salesforce behavior and grants zero Salesforce parity credit.

source.content: Database.SaveResult badSave = Database.insert(new Account(), false); System.assertEquals(false, badSave.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(null, badSave.getId()); System.assert(badSave.getErrors() != null && badSave.getErrors().size() > 0); Database.Error saveError = badSave.getErrors().get(0); System.assertEquals(StatusCode.REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING, saveError.getStatusCode()); System.assert(saveError.getMessage().contains('Required fields')); System.assert(saveError.getFields().contains('Name')); Account saved = new Account(Name = 'Wave 15 Saved'); Database.SaveResult saveResult = Database.insert(saved, false); System.assertEquals(true, saveResult.isSuccess()); System.assertNotEquals(null, saveResult.getId()); System.assertEquals(saved.Id, saveResult.id); System.assertEquals(true, saveResult.success); System.assertEquals(saveResult.getErrors(), saveResult.errors); System.assert(saveResult.equals(saveResult)); System.assertNotEquals(null, saveResult.hashCode()); System.assert(saveResult.toString().length() > 0); Database.SaveResult updateResult = Database.update(new Account(Id = saved.Id, Name = 'Wave 15 Updated'), false); System.assert(updateResult.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(saved.Id, updateResult.getId()); Account upsertNew = new Account(Name = 'Wave 15 Upsert New'); Database.UpsertResult upsertCreated = Database.upsert(upsertNew, false); System.assert(upsertCreated.isSuccess()); System.assert(upsertCreated.isCreated()); System.assertEquals(upsertCreated.getId(), upsertCreated.id); System.assertEquals(true, upsertCreated.success); System.assertEquals(true, upsertCreated.created); System.assertEquals(upsertCreated.getErrors(), upsertCreated.errors); System.assert(upsertCreated.equals(upsertCreated)); System.assertNotEquals(null, upsertCreated.hashCode()); System.assert(upsertCreated.toString().length() > 0); Database.UpsertResult upsertUpdated = Database.upsert(new Account(Id = upsertCreated.getId(), Name = 'Wave 15 Upsert Updated'), false); System.assert(upsertUpdated.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(false, upsertUpdated.isCreated()); System.assertEquals(upsertCreated.getId(), upsertUpdated.getId()); Account master = new Account(Name = 'Wave 15 Master'); insert master; Account duplicate = new Account(Name = 'Wave 15 Duplicate'); insert duplicate; Contact child = new Contact(LastName = 'Wave 15 Child', AccountId = duplicate.Id); insert child; Database.MergeResult merged = Database.merge(master, duplicate, false); System.assert(merged.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(master.Id, merged.getId()); System.assertEquals(1, merged.getMergedRecordIds().size()); System.assertEquals(duplicate.Id, merged.getMergedRecordIds().get(0)); System.assertEquals(1, merged.getUpdatedRelatedIds().size()); System.assertEquals(child.Id, merged.getUpdatedRelatedIds().get(0)); System.assertEquals(true, merged.success); System.assertEquals(master.Id, merged.id); System.assertEquals(merged.getMergedRecordIds(), merged.mergedrecordids); System.assertEquals(merged.getUpdatedRelatedIds(), merged.updatedrelatedids); System.assert(merged.equals(merged)); System.assertNotEquals(null, merged.hashCode()); System.assert(merged.toString().length() > 0); Account recycle = new Account(Name = 'Wave 15 Recycle'); insert recycle; Database.DeleteResult deleted = Database.delete(recycle, false); System.assert(deleted.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(recycle.Id, deleted.getId()); System.assertEquals(true, deleted.success); System.assertEquals(recycle.Id, deleted.id); System.assertEquals(deleted.getErrors(), deleted.errors); System.assert(deleted.equals(deleted)); System.assertNotEquals(null, deleted.hashCode()); System.assert(deleted.toString().length() > 0); Database.UndeleteResult restored = Database.undelete(recycle, false); System.assert(restored.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(recycle.Id, restored.getId()); System.assertEquals(true, restored.success); System.assertEquals(recycle.Id, restored.id); System.assertEquals(restored.getErrors(), restored.errors); System.assert(restored.equals(restored)); System.assertNotEquals(null, restored.hashCode()); System.assert(restored.toString().length() > 0); Database.delete(recycle, false); Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult emptied = Database.emptyRecycleBin(recycle); System.assert(emptied.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(recycle.Id, emptied.getId()); System.assertEquals(true, emptied.success); System.assertEquals(recycle.Id, emptied.id); System.assertEquals(emptied.getErrors(), emptied.errors); System.assert(emptied.equals(emptied)); System.assertNotEquals(null, emptied.hashCode()); System.assert(emptied.toString().length() > 0);
